meta.title: feat: Phase 7.1 - Basket Asset Performance Tracking
meta.body_summary: Add comprehensive basket asset performance tracking including returns, volatility, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown calculations, API endpoints, admin dashboard widgets, and scheduled commands.

perf_labels.notes: Large Claude-authored feature with financial calculations and tests merged by author without any review or performance evidence; outcome reflects self-managed prototype environment.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 10106 changed lines across 51 files, this is a large feature addition by absolute volume. It fits a self-contained roadmap phase with no external review, consistent with a prototype repository where author merges AI‑generated code directly.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comment text available; author merged after four self-authored commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Adds basket performance analytics including returns, volatility, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown, with caching for frequently accessed data.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Claude generated a multi‑file financial feature with models, service, API, admin widgets, and tests; merge without review shows a process boundary where the agent operates in a self‑service prototype setting.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler evidence, or before/after performance numbers; claims of caching and performance tracking are narrative only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No review‑induced regression or fix cycle; tests were adjusted in later commits by the author.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced BasketPerformance and ComponentPerformance models, migration, a BasketPerformanceService that computes returns, volatility, Sharpe ratio, and max drawdown, API controllers for performance endpoints, Filament admin widgets (chart, stats, table), a schedule command, and feature test with factories.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: A subsequent merge of main brought 6974 lines of unrelated changes, including large auto‑generated docs and new static pages; these are not part of the performance feature.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added all performance tracking code, migration, API, admin widgets, and tests in one large chunk (2876 lines).
Merge from main resolved trivial route conflict and imported many unrelated files.
Two smaller fix commits corrected factory definitions, test assertions, and unique ID generation to stabilise tests.

collaboration_trajectory: Author committed full feature implementation in a single commit.
Merged main to synchronise with upstream changes.
Applied two test‑fixing commits addressing factory mismatches and parallel execution reliability.
Merged directly without any review or external comment.
